status: implemented and matching hosts built; bounded engineering checks, not task qualification
public_visibility: ordinary-player structured/hybrid only; image allowlist unchanged

public_observe_fields.dialogue: sender UID/lifecycle, dialogue_id, kind, tag, content and native English text, exact offered response IDs/content/text/given_item; original typed dialogue retained
public_observe_fields.dialogue_markers: persistent validated server marker receipts independent of next prompt; also inspect_map
public_observe_fields.social_and_trade.pending_trade: trade_id, parties, phase, accept flags, offers, both synced inventories and native SitePrices valuations
public_observe_fields.last_trade_result: actual Event::TradeComplete; Completed means server commit; absent TradeId explicitly null
public_observe_fields.skill_tree: learned level, available/earned points, cost, prerequisite and unlockable readback
public_observe_fields.auxiliary_abilities: active_set, eligible native abilities, slot limit
public_observe_fields.nearby_entities: ordinary synced name and native English name_text, native Group, same_native_group and health; Friendly/Owned is not Group
public_observe_fields.quest_state: not replicated to ordinary player; only native dialogue/marker content is public

dialogue_action.response_id: only for respond; exact offered ID

social_action.legacy_player_invitation: invite_trade/invite_group use target_uid and exact target_alias; do not combine with target
social_action.invite_kind: respond_* requires observed Trade or Group

trade_action.slot: native inventory slot only for item mutations
trade_action.quantity: positive strict u32 only for mutations
trade_action.ours: boolean for mutations only; default true

effect_contract.unlock_skill: wait for subsequent synced level increment AND expected point deduction; timeout unknown, not proven no effect
effect_contract.configure_auxiliary_ability: wait for subsequent exact active slot readback; no claim of combat use/effect
effect_contract.trade_action: dispatch is not settlement; actual trade_complete result and inventory evidence are separate
effect_contract.dialogue_action: dispatch does not prove quest acceptance, resolution, or reward
effect_contract.healing: server health outcome contributor and current lifecycle joins; absence unknown; no exclusive net HP inference

private_oracle.enable: server-only VELOREN_PRIVATE_ORACLE_PATH; fresh create_new NDJSON file
private_oracle.engineering_fixture: optional server-only VELOREN_PRIVATE_NATIVE_FIXTURE=resident-smoke-v1; real RTSim residents and nearest existing economy; no quest auto-accept or price override
private_oracle.quest_states: real QuestId, typed Message versus Deliver versus Slay, participants/arbiter/timeout, explicit Option<bool> resolution and RTSim existence
private_oracle.slay_join: RTSim Actor::Npc -> server UID/entity generation; client lifecycle joined by UID within same run, not equal lifecycle strings
private_oracle.reward: successful per-item sender removal/recipient insertion is separate from quest resolution/deposit; quest_id unavailable on transfer and never guessed
private_oracle.transport: private file only; not exposed in ready/observe/events/frame/model responses
